quotelist.quote: Brand new for the 2024/2025 he Burton Family Tree 3D Channel Surfer Snowboard is your ticket to a super smooth and buttery ride on the slopes.
Directional Flat Top™ – Flat overall with a rocker nose for the steady stability and effortless float demanded by deep days and surfy terrain.

citation.reasoning: Evo is a major established retailer with detailed product listings sourced from manufacturer data. These quotes confirm the model name, season, and camber profile directly.

quotelist.quote: Shop the Family Tree 3D Channel Surfer Flat Top Snowboard and other all mountain, park, and powder boards from Burton.

citation.reasoning: Official Burton manufacturer page. The W25 model year is confirmed via the URL SKU. The page currently shows sold out but confirms the product existed and the official naming convention.

quotelist.quote: The result of rider collaboration and on-snow testing, the Burton 3D Family Tree Channel Surfer snowboard blends edge control with surfy freedom.

citation.reasoning: REI is a major and highly reputable US outdoor retailer. Their product listing confirms the 2024/2025 season designation and key features.

quotelist.quote: Featuring a 3D shape that instills a catch-free and buttery personality, along with a directional, swallow tail outline that guarantees effortless float.
For expert riders looking to carve deep turns, cruise fresh groomers, and approach the entire mountain like one endless wave.

citation.reasoning: Official Burton blog post from December 2024 introducing the 2025 Family Tree lineup. Primary source from manufacturer confirming the swallow tail shape, expert rider target, and that this is a new model. Marketing language, so medium credibility on subjective claims.

quotelist.quote: Each Family Tree board carries subtle yet colorful Audubon graphics that highlight its personality; the Channel Surfer mirrors the distinctive, charming behavior of the puffin.
All 2014 and newer Burton snowboards with The Channel™ mounting system are backed by a 3-year warranty from Burton from date of purchase.

citation.reasoning: REI listing for the 2025/2026 successor model. Confirms the Audubon puffin graphic theme and the 3-year warranty policy that also applies to the 2025 model.
